title: Presentations and predicates for geometric diagram-site tensor shifts
statement: Let A be a natural-number sequence of commutative rings with arbitrary adjacent ring maps δ. For every scheme W, form its full vertical pro-etale sequence site and the ring sheaf obtained from the constant ring sheaves A_n with their transition maps [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections, def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Define Modules as module sheaves over this system ring, Complex as unbounded integer cochain complexes, Derived as their ordinary unbounded derived category, tensor as the published K-flat-derived tensor, and unitComplex as the native degree-zero ring complex. Pullback presents exact geometric inverse image for a scheme map v: its ring map has the canonical constant-ring components; its set and module right adjoints are the specified sequence-site direct images; its adjunction unit agrees with the generator normalization. TensorConstraints records the normalized two-shift, associator and symmetry maps and representative-normalized action unitors. TensorCoherence records their single-slot zero/addition laws, extraction, signed interchange, associativity, symmetry and unitor shift equations. ChainSignedCoherence, ChainPullbackCoherence and ChainUnitCoherence are the explicit whole-system chain-map and summand formulas. TensorPullback records the representative-normalized derived tensor comparison and preservation of resolving complexes; ShiftCoherence is its simultaneous shift square. Models consists of such data over every W and v with adjunction-mate compositors whose right-module maps are fixed on sections by the scheme pullbackComp isomorphism. Models.Coherence collects simultaneous resolutions and the displayed chain, tensor, pullback, compositor and equality-shift identities. These are precisely the unchanged definitions formerly housed with lem-pur-diagram-pullback-monoidal-shift-models; no existence assertion is part of this definition.
